scenes.title: The Garden of Eden
beats: God planted a beautiful garden in a place called Eden, full of trees with delicious fruit, and a sparkling river to water it all.
He put Adam in the garden to take care of it. Adam could eat from any tree — except one: the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

layers.prompt: The Garden of Eden: a lush, glowing paradise of fruit trees, flowers and a sparkling river that splits into four streams, with peaceful deer and birds. Adam walks among the trees, right of center, looking around in wonder

scenes.title: Naming the Animals
beats: God brought every animal and bird to Adam, to see what he would call them. And whatever Adam called each one — that was its name!
But none of the animals was just right to be Adam’s partner.

layers.prompt: A sunny meadow in the garden: animals of every kind gather around Adam, right of center — a lion, an elephant, a giraffe, a peacock, a rabbit, a hippo, a zebra and birds — while Adam points and smiles, giving each one a name

scenes.title: God Makes Eve
beats: So God made Adam fall into a deep sleep. And from Adam’s side, God made a woman: Eve.
When Adam saw her, he was so happy! “At last — someone just like me!” And God brought them together.

layers.prompt: A flowery glade under a great blossoming tree in warm golden light: Adam meets Eve for the first time, right of center, both smiling in amazement

scenes.title: The Sneaky Snake
beats: Now the snake was the sneakiest of all the animals. “Did God really say you can’t eat from any tree?” he asked Eve.
“You won’t die,” the snake lied. “If you eat it, you’ll be like God!”
So Eve took the fruit and ate it, and gave some to Adam, and he ate it too.

layers.prompt: In the middle of the garden stands a great tree heavy with shining golden fruit; a sly green-and-gold snake curls along a branch, right of center, whispering to Eve, who looks up at the fruit

Under the great tree heavy with shining golden fruit: Eve holds out a golden fruit with a bite taken out of it to Adam, who stands beside her reaching for it, right of center, while the sly green-and-gold snake grins from the branch above

scenes.title: Where Are You?
beats: That evening, they heard God walking in the garden — and they hid among the trees.
“Where are you?” God called. Adam said, “I was afraid, so I hid.” Their wrong choice had broken their friendship with God.

layers.prompt: Evening in the garden as a cool breeze blows: Adam and Eve hide behind big leafy bushes, right of center, peeking out, worried and ashamed, while soft golden light shines through the trees from the left

scenes.title: A Promise
beats: Sin had come into the world, and Adam and Eve had to leave the garden. But God still loved them. He even made them warm clothes to wear.
And God made a promise: one day, a child would be born who would crush the snake’s head and make everything right again. That child would be Jesus.

layers.prompt: Adam and Eve, now dressed in simple warm garments of soft animal skins, walk out of the garden into a wide, rocky land, right of center, while behind them a shining angel guards the glowing garden gate

questions: Why do you think Adam and Eve hid from God?
Have you ever done something wrong and wanted to hide? What helps you say sorry?
God still loved Adam and Eve, and made them a promise. How does God show us He loves us?

verse.text: But the LORD God called out to the man, “Where are you?”
